hook.name: MemeowGuardHook
hook.description: Per-pool trading guard for memeow v4 launches: enforces anti-snipe windows (max ETH buy cap, exact-output refusal) with dynamic LP fees (base + optionally decaying snipe tax + surge fee for large buys + volatility EWMA surcharge), auto-burns a configurable share of buy outputs, and supports on-chain resting limit orders and trailing stop-loss orders filled atomically as price crosses their ticks.
